_comment: Night 4: character, mood, pose, icon, culture, fate, enclave, ui and per-kind style shelves. Only char.sarah.prefix is real text — William's own prefix (2026-11-10 02:25). Every TODO is Fable's (with William) to write; submit and produce queue refuse a TODO block. produce plan adds culture.<town> / fate.<fate> / enclave.<from> blocks here as it meets new towns.
